title: Stanley McDaniel's book on NASA's failure to investigate Mars structures

tellings.quote: Stanley McDaniel a professor ameritus at Sonoma State University wrote a 200-page book about NASA's failure to properly investigate the structures on Mars

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Stanley McDaniel, a retired professor at Sonoma State University, wrote a 200-page book in the 1990s about how NASA, the US space agency, failed to properly study what he called structures on Mars. Michels raises it to suggest the agency looked away from possible signs of past life there.
